A balloon and a glass jar both contain particles of the same ideal gas and are connected as shown. The tap connecting the balloon and the glass jar between A and B is closed. The pressure and the temperature in both the balloon and the glass jar are p and T respectively. The initial volume of the balloon is 8V and the volume of the glass jar is 4V.

When the tap is opened, the temperature of the gas particles does not change, while the pressure in both the balloon and the glass jar becomes 2p.

What is the new volume of the balloon?

  1. V
  2. 2V
  3. 4V
  4. 16V
